SDCard Block Count

Absolute Address:
Base Offset:
0x2c
Size:
0x4
Source:
adc_acquisition_reg_definition.rdl

Description

Number of blocks in one CMD25 session. In SDCARD_CONTINUOUS mode a session covers one frame (one SRAM bank), so this is the blocks per bank (4 for a full 2 KiB bank); in SDCARD_PULSE mode the single session covers both banks, so it is the blocks in F0 plus F1 (8 for two full banks). Written by the HW copy engine into SDHCI BLOCK_COUNT at the start of every session, with block-count-enable set so the controller ends the session -- and raises TRANSFER_COMPLETE -- after exactly this many blocks. Also the amount SDCARD_BLOCK_ADDR advances per session when SDCARD_ADDR_MODE selects block units.
